contentYaml.description: YAML content for the direction layer

domain.description: Domain tag for L2 layers (e.g. saas, fintech)

preferredModel.description: Preferred LLM model for spec generation (L3 only)

workspaceId.description: Required for L3; the workspace this layer applies to

engines.description: Availability status for each execution engine (cached 30s)

branchName.description: Git branch name (if run uses worktree isolation)

worktreePath.description: Worktree path (if run uses worktree isolation)

storyIds.description: Specific story IDs to retry (all failed if omitted)

autoMerge.description: Auto-merge worktree branch to main on successful run

autoWorktree.description: Create git worktree for isolated run

includeGraph.description: Include knowledge graph context in the pipeline run

agentOverride.description: Override the execution agent for this spec

thinkingEnabled.description: Enable extended thinking for this spec

brief.description: Additional brief context for the new stories

excluded.description: Set to true to exclude story from pipeline runs

brief.description: Plain-English description of the feature to build
brief.example: Add Stripe billing with monthly and annual plans

model.description: LLM model override (defaults to workspace L3 preferred_model)

multiPass.description: Enable multi-pass spec generation for richer output

specBrief.description: Alias for brief (either field is accepted)

storyCount.description: Target number of user stories to generate (default 10)

title.description: Spec slug/title (auto-generated from brief if omitted)

workspaceId.description: Workspace to generate the spec for

customColumns.description: Specs assigned to user-defined custom columns

done.description: Specs where all stories passed or manually marked done

inProgress.description: Approved specs that are running, queued, or awaiting a run

apiVersion.description: Semver for the public API contract. Only changes on breaking contract changes.

schemaVersion.description: Highest applied schema_migrations version as a string.
